name: Danger BLUE
source:
You play as a young man who's left everything behind, seeking peace in a quiet town where no one knows his name. But as you build new bonds,  friendships, maybe even love... it becomes clear that the past isn't done with you yet.

Why does the world sometimes look blue? What are you really afraid of? And can you trust what you see... or your own mind?
